caption: The drawing depicts a wooden corner cabinet with two separate sections, each with a pair of rectangular doors. The cabinet is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a wooden texture, and has a trapezoidal shape to fit into a corner. The upper section features two larger doors, each comprising two panels, positioned side by side in the center of the piece. The lower section also has two doors, each with a single panel, smaller than the upper doors, and includes visible hinges and a keyhole indicating it can be locked. The cabinet is crowned with a protruding molded cornice at the top and has a matching base molding at the bottom. The sides of the cabinet angle back to allow for its corner placement. The background is plain and off-white, and in the lower right portion of the image is a handwritten name, "Geo. W. Verillles."
title: Corner Cupboard
